f1.description: voiced pitch frames within 10 dB of the loudest frames (ignoring the top 1 %, so a click doesn't count), with F1 in 250-1000 Hz (the formant ceiling following the voice)

f2.description: voiced pitch frames within 10 dB of the loudest frames (ignoring the top 1 %, so a click doesn't count), with F1 in 250-1000 Hz (the formant ceiling following the voice)

f3.description: voiced pitch frames within 10 dB of the loudest frames (ignoring the top 1 %, so a click doesn't count), with F1 in 250-1000 Hz (the formant ceiling following the voice)

weight.description: corrected H1*-A3* on measurable voiced pitch frames

jitter.description: local jitter per voiced stretch, at the stretch end

size.description: apparent vocal-tract length from F3-F4 on voiced pitch frames within 10 dB of the loudest frames (ignoring the top 1 %, so a click doesn't count), with F1 in 250-1000 Hz (the formant ceiling following the voice)
